links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified plastic surgery webpage text, compared on six readability metrics
links.outcome: Readability metric scores (six metrics) of original versus ChatGPT-revised webpage text
links.effect: Significant improvement from baseline in all six readability metric scores with the specific-instruction prompt on ChatGPT 3.5 (all P ≤ 0.05); no further improvement with ChatGPT 4.0
links.quote: Significant improvements were achieved from baseline in six readability metric scores using a specific-instruction prompt with ChatGPT 3.5 (all P ≤ 0.05).
